ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with highly localized high-intensity white clusters at the distal tips; macro-level ratio is significantly skewed towards black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast contiguous white clusters mapped to the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes. Sparse, stochastically distributed high-intensity pixel points across the interior dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a narrow divergence and deep vertical penetration at the central confluence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the continuous trailing edges of both lobes with high-frequency pixel variations and significant jaggedness on the inner right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the lateral outer margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular to irregular high-contrast white pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations concentrated on the distal lobe tips and a highly irregular, jagged trailing edge profile.
